name: resources-sandbox-memory-limits

controlConfigInputs.name: sandbox_memory_limit_max
controlConfigInputs.description: Maximum memory limit allowed for Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate containers.

description: Checks that Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate containers have memory limits set and that they do not exceed the configured maximum.
remediation: Set spec.podTemplate.spec.containers[].resources.limits.memory to a value within the configured ceiling.
